commands.name: script syntax
commands.run: for f in scripts/*.sh scripts/lib/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done

invariants.name: no literal colours in the website stylesheet
invariants.diagnosis: The website is a consumer of design/tokens.json: every colour it paints comes from website/tokens.css, generated from that file. A literal hex or rgb() in styles.css is a colour defined somewhere other than the source, which the next token change silently leaves behind. Sizes are deliberately not covered: the page vocabulary block at the top of styles.css holds display sizes and section rhythm the app-scale token set does not, and website/README.md says what may go there. Legitimate exception: none. The one literal colour on the site is the theme-color meta tag in index.html, which cannot read a custom property and is outside this grep's paths on purpose.

generated.diagnosis: A non-empty diff means either website/tokens.css or the favicon was hand-edited, or design/tokens.json changed without the site being regenerated. Both are bugs: a hand edit is destroyed by the next run and the gap that prompted it survives, and a stale tokens.css is the website painting last month's palette. Regenerate and commit the output alongside the token change. The generator reads a committed local file, so it works offline and has no legitimate skip.
